description: Founded in 1878 as a college in the spirit of the Enlightenment, Stockholm University is a premier public research institution and one of Scandinavia's largest universities. It accommodates over 30,000 students across four primary faculties: Law, Humanities, Social Sciences, and Natural Sciences. Located in the heart of Sweden's capital, the university's main campus is uniquely situated within the Royal National City Park. Globally recognised for high-calibre research and international academic programs, the institution is consistently ranked among the world's top universities.
